title: Register for sales tax, VAT or GST
summary: Determine sales tax, VAT or GST registration obligations from the company’s activities and customer locations, register where required, configure collection and schedule returns and remittances.

parts.title: Choose an indirect-tax platform
parts.guidance: Identify whether the company needs calculation, nexus assessment, registration, returns, remittance or several services. Compare platforms against its products, customer locations, billing systems and required jurisdictions, including exclusions and adviser involvement. Check integration and data-access needs before purchasing. A supported market in a platform does not determine whether the company must register or its product is taxable there.

execution.rationale: Compare tax-platform coverage and integration evidence against the company's products, locations and required services.

parts.title: Connect billing data and assess indirect-tax registration obligations
parts.guidance: Reconcile imported transactions to billing, including dates, locations, products, refunds and marketplace handling. Add physical business presence to the assessment. Check the platform’s flagged states against current state rules and measurement periods with the tax adviser. Preserve the data snapshot and assumptions; a detected threshold signal still needs a company-specific registration conclusion.

execution.rationale: Stripe Tax's Dashboard imports line-item CSV transactions, reports validation errors and exports itemized data for reconciliation with billing. Its threshold view supports the sales analysis; physical presence, marketplace treatment and registration conclusions require the retained company facts and tax-adviser review. Imported tax classifications and amounts can conflict, so preserve and reconcile the underlying data and assumptions.

parts.title: Review the jurisdictions where registration is required
parts.guidance: Review the company’s establishment, supplies and customer locations against the applicable indirect-tax rules. Confirm registration obligations with the tax adviser before filing or enabling collection.

execution.rationale: The tax adviser reviews sales and presence records digitally and records the basis and timing of each registration decision.

parts.title: Register with the applicable indirect-tax authorities
parts.guidance: Use the registration route required for the company’s sales tax, VAT or GST obligations. Confirm the registration facts and scope with the tax adviser, obtain approval to submit and retain the assigned identifiers and effective dates.

options.title: United States — Streamlined Sales Tax registration
options.summary: Check which approved state registrations the Streamlined Sales Tax service supports. Review the selected states, entity, effective dates and resulting obligations before submitting through the authorized filing route. Track each state’s issued account and connect it to collection and return preparation. Use the appropriate separate registration process for states or taxes outside the service.

verify.how: Each state issues a sales-tax permit or account number — required before collecting tax there.

execution.rationale: Streamlined Sales Tax documents online registration for approved participating-state selections and entity details.

options.title: India - GST registration
options.summary: Assess the seller’s establishment, service, customers and transaction flow with the tax adviser to identify the appropriate Indian GST category. Check whether the non-resident online-services route actually applies. Use current official instructions for business and signatory details and the required filing authorization. After registration, establish the corresponding invoicing and return process from that Indian assessment.

references.title: GST portal non-resident online services registration

execution.rationale: The authorized employer representative completes GST registration and configures the required digital invoicing and return workflow, retaining personal verification.

options.title: UK - one VAT registration (MTD)
options.summary: Assess establishment, taxable supplies, turnover and customer arrangements under current HMRC rules. Determine whether registration is required or elective and the effective date before preparing the application. Submit through the company’s authorized route, then use the issued registration to set up invoices, digital records and returns. Use the UK assessment to set the account’s tax treatment.
options.when: Indirect-tax registration in the United Kingdom

execution.rationale: The authorized operator completes VAT registration and configures the selected digital record and return workflow after the adviser confirms applicability.

options.title: Germany - VAT ID + OSS
options.summary: Review establishment, products, customer status and transaction locations for German and EU VAT. Distinguish domestic registration or identification needs from an eligible One Stop Shop scheme and the transactions it covers. Confirm effective dates before authorized filings and configure invoices and returns accordingly. Keep obligations outside the selected scheme visible; OSS does not replace every national registration.

references.title: European Commission VAT One Stop Shop

execution.rationale: The authorized operator completes the applicable VAT registrations and configures digital invoices and reporting for the selected scheme.

options.title: France - TVA + OSS
options.summary: Assess French and EU VAT using the seller’s establishment, supplies, customer status and places of supply. Identify any appropriate One Stop Shop scheme alongside remaining national obligations. Resolve the registration plan before authorized submissions, then set invoicing, records and returns to that treatment. Separate scheme-covered transactions from those still requiring French or other national handling.

references.title: European Commission VAT One Stop Shop

execution.rationale: The authorized filer completes the applicable French and OSS registrations and configures the corresponding digital records and returns.

geoResolutions.label: Streamlined Sales Tax registration
geoResolutions.guidance: Once revenue crosses state thresholds you owe sales tax where your customers are: connect billing to a tax platform, run the nexus study, register with each state’s department of revenue, turn on collection at checkout, and put the filings on autopilot. Check which approved state registrations the Streamlined Sales Tax service supports. Review the selected states, entity, effective dates and resulting obligations before submitting through the authorized filing route. Track each state’s issued account and connect it to collection and return preparation. Use the appropriate separate registration process for states or taxes outside the service.

After registration, establish the corresponding invoicing and return process from that Indian assessment.

geoResolutions.label: One national VAT registration (activated by the início de atividade declaration) replaces per-state registrations, and EU-wide B2C digital sales consolidate into a single One-Stop-Shop return instead of per-country filings.

Genuinely nexus-like: register for GST/HST once worldwide taxable supplies pass the $30,000 small-supplier threshold, then layer the separate provincial registrations — QST in Quebec, PST in BC, Saskatchewan and Manitoba — where your customers are.
Instead of per-state sales tax there is one national GST registration — compulsory once turnover reaches $60,000 in the last 12 months (or is expected to in the next 12), handled in myIR.

Instead of per-state sales tax there is one national GST registration — compulsory past S$1 million of taxable turnover (law rule sg.gst-registration-threshold) — with returns filed through the myTax Portal.

Instead of per-state sales tax there is one national GST registration — required within 21 days once GST turnover meets the $75,000 threshold (law rule au.gst-registration-threshold) — with GST then reported on business activity statements.

There is no multi-state nexus question: a single national VAT registration covers the country, applied for per place of business with the district tax office within 20 days of starting business (Value-Added Tax Act Article 8) and managed through Hometax.
There is no sales tax, GST or VAT to register for anywhere in Hong Kong — the business taxes are profits tax, stamp duty and the business registration fee — so the nexus question never arises.

There is no multi-state nexus question: one national VAT registration covers the country, due within three working days of crossing the 40,000-euro threshold (law rule ee.vat-registration-threshold), with the EU OSS available in e-MTA for cross-border B2C supply.

parts.title: Enable tax collection on checkout and invoices
parts.guidance: Configure products, locations, exemptions and effective dates from the reviewed tax treatment. Test invoices, refunds and representative customer types before enabling the approved production changes. Reconcile early collected tax to expectations and confirm required registrations are in place. Decide how later product or customer-status changes reach the people maintaining tax settings.

execution.rationale: Stripe documents Dashboard tax settings, sandbox checkout/invoice tests and tax-calculation inspection. The workflow applies reviewed treatment, verifies refunds and reconciles collected tax; registration and production approval remain prerequisites.

parts.title: Schedule required returns and remittances
parts.guidance: Use issued accounts and agency-assigned frequencies to schedule returns, including any required zero filings. Reconcile collected tax, refunds and credits before each return. Configure the company’s actual filing and remittance approvals and escalation for failed submissions or debits before enabling recurring actions. Keep acceptance and payment evidence with each return and revisit the schedule when registrations change.

execution.rationale: Avalara Managed Returns documents browser controls for state accounts, filing frequencies, reconciliation, return approval and downloading filing/payment confirmations. Funding authority is signed by the responsible person; failed funding is escalated through support. Automatic approval at the monthly cutoff means recurring filing and debit authority must be settled before activation. Account-specific forms, zero-return duties and bank restrictions remain review gates.

metadata.supportReason: Tax platforms watch nexus thresholds, calculate at checkout, and file returns over their APIs; the state registration portals are manual form work and the exposure review is a judgment call.
